## Per-PR decisions

| PR   | Decision                                                                          | Result                                                                                                                                              |
| ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| #103 | Accept five compatible direct dependency updates; retain two compatibility bounds | `@google/genai` 2.31.0; React Query and its devtools 5.104.5; Chart.js 4.6.1; lucide-react 1.61.0. KaTeX remains 0.18.11 and ts-fsrs remains 5.4.1. |
| #104 | Accept                                                                            | TypeScript ESLint plugin/parser 8.72.0 and PostCSS 8.5.31 in the lockfile.                                                                          |
| #105 | Accept with provider compatibility repair                                         | Anthropic SDK 1.1.0, with explicit existing API version and API-key transport, plus real SDK request serialization tests.                           |
| #106 | Accept                                                                            | Relay dotenv 18.0.9.                                                                                                                                |
| #107 | Accept                                                                            | Relay bun-types 1.4.4.                                                                                                                              |

KaTeX 0.19 is outside Tiptap mathematics 3.32.0's declared peer range and
caused the source PR's clean installs to fail. FSRS runtime validation,
diagnostics and persisted provenance explicitly require ts-fsrs 5.4.1.
Those two upgrades need coordinated changes and are deferred rather than
forced through installation flags. JSON lockfile conflicts were resolved
with a three-way merge against the common baseline. Both final lockfiles
passed normal `npm ci`, without `--force` or `--legacy-peer-deps`.

Anthropic SDK 1.1.0 changes both its default API version and its API-key
header. The application retains `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01` and
`x-api-key`, and suppresses the new default Authorization header. Three
tests exercise the actual installed SDK with a mocked HTTP transport:
text options/authentication/version, image input and text extraction,
and provider rejection. No Anthropic model request was made.

## Effective Dependabot configuration

Dependabot reads `.github/dependabot.yml` from the default branch, `main`.
Release-only ignores therefore did not prevent #103 from proposing the
same incompatible versions again.

The acceptance configuration explicitly targets `release/note-baseline-prod`
for every ecosystem, keeps the TypeScript/KaTeX/FSRS/ESLint bounds and
groups Vitest with its coverage provider. A separate local branch contains
only the effective default-branch configuration repair:

- Branch: `chore/dependabot-config-main-20261027`.
- Base: `origin/main`, observed at `919d41f`.
- Commit: `ac325f58f50e25a0185a4ad20407d8607d7b7540`.
- Worktree: `/home/unknow/projects/.worktrees/WQN-dependabot-config-main-20261027`.
- Changed file: `.github/dependabot.yml` only; it matches this branch's file.

That companion change must reach `main` for the version bounds and grouping
to take effect. Neither local branch has been published, and the original
cloud PRs have not been closed or merged by this work.

The first sandboxed Turbopack attempt made no further progress and was
terminated. Its exit 143 is not a passing build. The identical default
command subsequently exited zero with local port/process access; logs are
in `artifacts/dependabot-build-unrestricted.log`. It reports two filesystem
tracing warnings in the unchanged `skill-runtime.ts` source.

Validation used a uniquely named owned Supabase stack. Voice/STD tests used
a disposable `wqn_voice_test_*` database inside that stack. Its copy excluded
pg_cron because that extension can only be installed in `postgres`; the
complete migration and SQL checks ran on the original temporary `postgres`
database with pg_cron present. The stack was stopped after verification.
Existing developer stacks were not reset or migrated.

Full command output is retained in this worktree's ignored `artifacts/`
directory (`dependabot-*.log`, audit JSON reports), plus
`artifacts-dependabot-lint.log`.

## Acceptance boundaries

These results establish local dependency, request-contract, database and
build compatibility. Combined-branch remote CI, browser/manual UI acceptance,
real provider behavior and physical-device acceptance have not been run.
No production database, deployment, firmware or Release/main branch was
changed. Cloud PR #109 remains subject to its own merge and acceptance.
